clips.title: The story
paras: Free at Last is a rescue mission atop the windswept spires of Darkcloud Pinnacle. Lakota Windsong, a tauren woman held captive by Arnak Grimtotem, needs protection as she flees her captor's stronghold and returns to her friend Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post.

The Grimtotem clan's aggressive presence in Thousand Needles is not limited to skirmishes over land. Arnak Grimtotem sought to take Lakota Windsong as his bride, but when she refused his advances, he chose violence. Arnak returned in the night, struck down Lakota's brother when he tried to defend her, and dragged her away to Darkcloud Pinnacle.

Perched across the high wooden suspension bridges above Thousand Needles, Darkcloud Pinnacle is swarming with hostile Grimtotem warriors. Escorting Lakota requires navigating the descent while fighting off waves of Grimtotem bandits intent on recapturing her before she reaches the canyon floor.

Once safely down from the pinnacle, Lakota makes her way back to the safety of Freewind Post. Her companion, Thalia Amberhide, receives the news with immense relief but deep mourning for Lakota's fallen brother, offering his remaining belongings as a token of gratitude to those who brought her home alive.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Arnak thinks we're going to be married... But after I declined his offer he came back that night and kidnapped me. My brother tried to stop him, but Arnak was too strong. He... He slew my brother and then brought me here. My poor brother...
Friend, could you escort me out of the Darkcloud Pinnacle? Please... I need to get back to Thalia! She must be worried sick about me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. Deep in my bones I knew that she would find her way back to me. She told me of your bravery and how you helped her escape. These items belonged to her brother. I know she would want you to have them.
